endpoint: POST /api/v1/busy/:id/ (retail sell: {kind, amount, price, estimatedSecondsToFinish, forceQuality})
semantics: Client estimate (kce/u$r/f$r chain) and server calculateRetailDuration are the SAME formula: g = 370*(levelsPerUnit*modeledSold+1)*isrFactor(B=2.28)*(d/2*(1+quality/12*0.3)); optimal = cost + (g+wages)/adjDemand; adjRevenue = g - (price-optimal)^2*(wages+g)/(optimal-cost)^2; tts = (units*(price-cost)*3600 - wages)/(adjRevenue+wages); seconds = tts/size*(1-salesMod/100). CRITICAL: the client divides unconditionally, so below-cost prices (numerator AND denominator negative) produce a small positive estimate. The server must not guard numerator>0 or its duration diverges from the displayed estimate. The client's max button caps at ceil(modeledSold*limit/3600) units. The server stays the duration authority (client-sent estimatedSecondsToFinish is ignored).
